name: Supabase
purpose: Account authentication, CV database and private file storage.
countries: Primary project hosting: Germany, as configured by the operator. Support and subprocessors may process data internationally; see the published subprocessor list.
retention: Guest recovery expires after 24 hours; expired uploads are removed by daily cleanup. Account content remains until deletion. Backup availability and expiry depend on the project plan; database backups do not include Storage objects.
safeguards: Private storage and authorized database access in the app. Provider publishes data-processing terms, subprocessor information and international-transfer safeguards: https://supabase.com/legal/customer-resources/data-processing-addendum

name: Vercel
purpose: Website hosting and backend request execution.
countries: Primary backend region: Germany, as configured by the operator. Global delivery, support and subprocessors may involve other countries, including the United States.
retention: Request/log retention depends on the service and plan. Our application omits CV content and credentials from operational logs; the operator targets 14 days for operational logs. Provider-held data follows Vercel retention policies and applicable contractual/legal obligations.
safeguards: Provider publishes a DPA and international-transfer safeguards: https://vercel.com/legal/dpa. Application logging does not control upstream platform retention.

name: OpenAI
purpose: Analyze extracted CV text and generate CV guidance and editing suggestions after AI permission. Relevant career/education context may be included; referral source is excluded.
countries: International processing, including the United States. This app uses the standard API endpoint; EU-only processing or zero-data-retention arrangements are not represented as configured.
retention: Chat Completions API: abuse-monitoring logs may contain inputs/outputs for up to 30 days by default, with legal/safety exceptions. Model-specific prompt caches may persist for up to 24 hours. No stored Chat Completion is requested by the app.
safeguards: API content is not used for model training by default. Provider publishes data controls and contractual safeguards: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/your-data. Withdrawal blocks future calls but cannot recall previously transmitted data.

name: Stripe
purpose: Checkout, subscription billing, payment security and legally required financial records; CV content and survey answers are not sent for payment processing.
countries: International processing, including the United States and India, as described in Stripe privacy information.
retention: Payment and financial records may remain after account deletion for legal, tax, accounting and fraud-prevention obligations. Stripe applies the periods required by applicable obligations; no universal retention period is asserted.
safeguards: Hosted payment interfaces and provider data-processing/transfer terms: https://stripe.com/legal/dpa and https://stripe.com/privacy.

name: Google Analytics
purpose: Optional, consent-based usage statistics and funnel measurement. No CV content, filenames, questionnaire answers, account IDs or authentication URLs are included in app analytics payloads.
countries: International processing through Google infrastructure; Germany-only processing is not promised.
retention: Standard GA4 event-level retention is configurable to 2 or 14 months; the actual property setting applies. Aggregate reporting may have different retention. Our browser analytics choice lasts 180 days and can be changed at any time.
safeguards: No Google analytics script or events before opt-in; Global Privacy Control overrides acceptance. App requests disable advertising personalization and Google Signals. Provider terms: https://business.safety.google/adsprocessorterms/. Advertising and automatic-measurement property settings must match the app policy.

name: Google Sign-In
purpose: Optional Google account authentication, sharing the sign-in identity needed to create or access the account. Separate from optional Google Analytics.
countries: Google processes identity data internationally under its privacy policy; Germany-only processing is not promised.
retention: Google account data is governed by Google account settings and its privacy policy. The app retains the linked account profile until deletion.
safeguards: OAuth sign-in through Supabase. Provider identity/privacy information: https://policies.google.com/privacy.
